statement: A pull request that records a preregistered result must also update every public entry that announced the run as not yet run. The 0.6.7 confirmation result (#511) landed under docs/experiments/, while the RUBRIC_CHANGELOG entry for the change it measured still said that no public before-and-after had run, through the release itself. When a result lands, search the rubric changelog and release notes for the announcing entry, and add a measured section under it, leaving the entry as written, in the same PR or the next one before release.
